newsitem.title: KUWAIT: China tells Kuwait no Iraq economic cooperation.
newsitem.headline: China tells Kuwait no Iraq economic cooperation.

text.p: China on Sunday reassured Kuwait that it has no current plans for economic cooperation with the Gulf state's former occupier Iraq in compliance with U.N. trade sanctions.

"A Chinese official memorandum received by (Kuwait's foreign) ministry stressed that China has no plans for economic cooperation with Baghdad at the current stage," the official Kuwait News Agency (KUNA) reported.

China was reacting to media reports saying Beijing was involved in an $8 billion oil deal with Baghdad along with British firms in violation of the embargo against Iraq imposed by the United Nations since its 1990-91 occupation of Kuwait, the agency said.
"Beijing will not execute any such project before the international embargo is lifted," KUNA quoted the Chinese memorandum as saying.
Iraq is allowed limited oil sales worth $2 billion over a six-month span to finance payments for food and humanitarian supplies under the supervision of the world body.
